description: Essential Scala 3 utilities for JVM, Scala.js, and Scala Native: object wiring, logging, JSON/MessagePack, Rx, HTTP client/server, RPC, MCP servers, and testing. The Scala 3 successor of Airframe.
rules: Uni is Scala 3 only. Use indentation syntax, given/using, enum, and derives.
Derive JSON/MessagePack codecs with `derives Weaver` (wvlet.uni.weaver.Weaver) instead of writing them by hand.
In UniTest, write `(x >= 1) shouldBe true` instead of ScalaTest-style `x should be >= 1`.
Uni replaces Airframe for Scala 3 projects. Do not add Airframe artifacts for the same features.
Canonical imports, an Airframe migration table, and common mistakes: https://wvlet.org/uni/guide/for-ai-agents
